uiOnlyOpportunities.finding: All 7 sticker listings expired on 2026-09-20 and nothing replaced them. The shop has had zero sellable inventory for roughly 8 weeks.
uiOnlyOpportunities.suggestedAction: Renew the 7 expired listings (about $0.20 each, roughly $1.40 total) to restore the storefront immediately.
uiOnlyOpportunities.estimatedImpact: Unblocks everything. No other lever can work while the shop is empty.

uiOnlyOpportunities.finding: With listings live, Etsy now names 3 concrete factors hurting search visibility: Category, Not enough photos, and Return policy. These were invisible while the shop was empty.
uiOnlyOpportunities.suggestedAction: Work Etsy's own list: attach the existing 30-day return policy, add photos, and fix category assignment.
uiOnlyOpportunities.estimatedImpact: These are Etsy's stated ranking inputs, not inference - the highest-confidence SEO work available.

uiOnlyOpportunities.finding: All 7 listings carry an identical 10-tag set, so they compete with each other for the same queries instead of covering distinct ones, and 3 of the 13 tag slots go unused.
uiOnlyOpportunities.suggestedAction: Differentiate tags per listing and fill all 13 slots.
uiOnlyOpportunities.estimatedImpact: Widens the number of distinct searches the shop can appear in once listings are live.
uiOnlyOpportunities.status: DONE 2026-11-15 - 73 unique tags, 13 per listing, only 3 shared

uiOnlyOpportunities.finding: A refunded test order from 2026-05-20 has sat overdue for 175 days and still counts as Action Needed.
uiOnlyOpportunities.suggestedAction: Mark the order complete to clear the flag before real orders arrive.
uiOnlyOpportunities.estimatedImpact: Removes a standing fulfillment blemish ahead of Star Seller tracking starting at 5 orders.
uiOnlyOpportunities.status: BLOCKED - Etsy will not complete a fully refunded order via bulk action

uiOnlyOpportunities.finding: Zero listings have a return policy attached, and zero have video.
uiOnlyOpportunities.suggestedAction: Attach the existing 30-day return policy during renewal, and add video where practical.
uiOnlyOpportunities.estimatedImpact: Both are ranking and conversion inputs Etsy weighs directly.
uiOnlyOpportunities.status: PARTIAL 2026-11-15 - return policy on all 7; video still absent

uiOnlyOpportunities.finding: All 7 listings sit on the 'Home' shipping profile; the Printful profile is attached to none, despite POD being the fulfillment model.
uiOnlyOpportunities.suggestedAction: Confirm which profile should apply before relisting.
uiOnlyOpportunities.estimatedImpact: A mismatch here means shipping cost and timing quoted to buyers will not match how the item is actually fulfilled.

uiOnlyOpportunities.finding: The About story is still unwritten; Etsy's own dashboard flags it.
uiOnlyOpportunities.suggestedAction: Publish it via the existing updateShopAboutStory API path.
uiOnlyOpportunities.estimatedImpact: Flagged by Etsy as a trust and search-visibility input.

uiOnlyOpportunities.finding: Etsy refresh tokens expire after 90 days. The expiry silently disabled every API path - publishing, renewal, analytics, order watch - with no alarm. Re-authorized 2026-11-15.
uiOnlyOpportunities.suggestedAction: Have the daemon check token age each run and warn on Discord before expiry.
uiOnlyOpportunities.estimatedImpact: Prevents a repeat of the 8-week outage that let every listing expire unnoticed.
